title: Godot 4.4 crashes when hovering over auto-generated .log file in FileSystem dock
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in : 
Godot Engine v4.4.stable.official (4c311cbee68c0b66ff8ebb8b0defdd9979dd2a41)
Godot Engine v4.4.stable.steam (4c311cbee68c0b66ff8ebb8b0defdd9979dd2a41)

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.5176) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads)

**Downloaded/Installed from:**

### **Steps to Reproduce (Reproduction Steps):**
1. Download and import the following project:
   [[instancing_starter.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-docs-project-starters/releases/download/latest-4.x/instancing_starter.zip)](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-docs-project-starters/releases/download/latest-4.x/instancing_starter.zip)
2. In the FileSystem dock, Godot automatically generates a `.log` file in the `.godot` directory or the project root (e.g., `Godot.20250311-140749-632.log`).
3. When hovering the mouse over the `.log` file, the Godot IDE crashes immediately.

---

### **Minimal Reproduction Project (MRP):**
[[instancing_starter.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-docs-project-starters/releases/download/latest-4.x/instancing_starter.zip)](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-docs-project-starters/releases/download/latest-4.x/instancing_starter.zip)

---

### **Additional Information:**
- **This bug occurs in both the Steam version and the Godot official Windows-x86_64 version.**
- **Possible Cause:** The Godot FileSystem dock may be trying to parse the `.log` file incorrectly, causing an exception.
- **Temporary Workaround:** Deleting the `.log` file or avoiding hovering over it prevents the crash, but the `.log` file is regenerated every time the project runs, making the issue persistent.

Please investigate and provide a fix. Thank you for your contribution to the community!
